faq.q: Gij youxyi lawz ndei hawj boux miz binghcwhceh?
faq.a: Youzheiq ndei couh dwg gānghdaeuz, gvanxsik laengboux caeuq mbouj miz aepfaek: doohbieng hung bwhdoiq, faenloih, pinjdooh gānghdaeuz, ciemx hoenx vah laux geizlawz cungj rox, daemxsaek, doohbieng binghgo caeuq kabbienq dauqnamh. Seiqndei roek couh dwg aen boux ranhmwngz ngoenzneix heiqvwnz gaeuq. Mbouj aeu aen geiqseiz, geiqfaen caeuq cungj gij baenzneix lumj gouq gauj.

faq.q: Gij youzheiq boux miz binghcizdai neix mbouj aeu cienz lō?
faq.a: Dwg. Moix aen youzheiq caeuq doohbieng aen ndei aeu daeuj daeclaeg youq cungj Creative Activities cungj dwg mienjfeiq, mbouj aeu danghcih, mbouj aeu danghgi caeuq haehcaeh. Youzheiq neix ndaej yungh souhcih, bingzbengj roxnaeuz denhnauj liujlanyih daeuj caenh.

faq.q: Gij youzheiq rengznauj neix mizndaej fangsik binghcizdai lō?
faq.a: Gij yenzgiu hwnjdaeuj mbouj miz ndaej bauh youzheiq lawz baenz fangsik binghcizdai, Creative Activities cungj mbouj faenjsing gijneix miz gij gung'yungq liauqbingh roxnaeuz fangsik. Gij youzheiq gouneix dwg aeu daeuj heiqvwnz caeuq doxcanh heiq doengzranz. Faenh gienhgangh rengznauj gouneix yaek gangj cingjcangh gij yenzgiu rox caeuq mbouj rox gijmaz.

faq.q: Gij youzheiq neix hab aeu boux miz bingh Alzheimer's daeuj caenh lō?
faq.a: Hab. Bingh Alzheimer's dwg gij gwnz daegbienh aen baengh daeuj miz binghcizdai, gij youzheiq neix couh dwg yawj gijneix daeuj guh: doohbieng hung hix laiz mbouj cienz biet, gij genhcak noiq, mbouj aeu geiq caeuq mbouj miz guh loek. Bwhdoiq, faenloih caeuq ciemx hoenx vah laux rox roek dwg baengh gij doxgaiq rox laux mbouj dwg daeuj hac sinh.

faq.q: Boux miz binghcizdai ndanglaeng hix ndaej caenh gij hozdung neix lō?
faq.a: Ndaej laiz, aeu miz boux doxcanh youq biengz. Ndaej aeu Ra aen doxgung song aen doohbieng, Siengpian song doiq seiq aen kab, aen yieb daemxsaek roxnaeuz aen seiz heiq naeb haenh daeuj haeujdaeuz. Guh aen nguhnguh noiq, baengh gij simcing boux ranhmwngz heiq, de laeuh le couh dingx.

faq.q: Gij swhliu gou miz ndaej baojmid lō?
faq.a: Vangzcan gou mbouj aeu ciengqhoh caeuq mbouj miz gvanghgo. Gou yungh Google Analytics daeuj rox yieb lawz miz boux daeuj yawj. Gij siengpian mwngz genh aeu daeuj Siengpian song doiq neix couh youq ndaw liujlanyih mwngz heiq, mbouj yaek sanghcanz bae gizlawz.

Creative Activities dwg aen duidoiq iq, guh gij doohbieng hozdung cinghcingh hab bouxdaeuz aeu ranz caeuq boux yawjcoz daeuj yungh, miz youq vangzcan caeuq app mienjfeiq. Gouneix mbouj dwg yiswh, gij youq neix cungj mbouj dwg kiensieng yiyliau.

about.bodyHtml:
Who it is for

Anyone caring for someone: a parent, a grandparent, a child, a partner, a friend, or a person living with dementia. Families, older adults and activity staff can all use the same pages.

What we believe

The point of an activity is the moment itself: a conversation, a smile, the satisfaction of putting two pictures together, or simply sitting close. It is not to measure anyone, push them further or prove anything.

Many brain-training apps are designed around speed, scores, streaks and levels. For someone who is tired, unwell or living with dementia, that can feel like an exam they cannot pass. We designed the opposite, and we hold ourselves to these rules:

  • Nothing to fail. No clock, score, move counter, lives, streaks, confetti or countdowns, on any screen.
  • Recognition over recall. Pictures stay showing by default. Prompts invite conversation and never quiz names or memories.
  • Big, plain and steady. Large text and pictures, high contrast, and controls that stay in the same place.
  • Adult dignity. Real-world pictures and plain, warm words. No cartoons, sing-song praise or emoji rewards.
  • An easy way out. “Done for now” is always visible. Stopping halfway is a good outcome.
  • Private by default. No accounts or ads. Photos you choose stay on your device.

What we do not claim

Our games and activities are for enjoyment and connection. They do not diagnose, test, measure, treat, slow or prevent dementia or Alzheimer’s disease, and no one should choose them for that reason. When we write about health research, we say plainly where the evidence is weak, and we never connect it to our own activities.

Who we are

Creative Activities is a small independent team. We are not clinicians. Our guides are written from published guidance by organizations such as the National Institute on Aging and the Alzheimer’s Association, and every guide lists its sources. Read how we write and check our pages.

Tell us what would help

We would love to hear what works for you and what does not, especially from people living with dementia, family caregivers and activity staff. Email {email}.

editorial.title: Yiengh Dou Sij Caeuq Gwnj Yieb Dou
editorial.description: Yiengh Creative Activities ra saw, sij, caemh giz daeuj caeuq gvaq moq yieb hozdung binghcizdaih caeuq gengjgeiq naonao, caeuq maz dou caenh mbouj baengh ok.
editorial.bodyHtml:
Our sources

We base our guides on public guidance from organizations such as the National Institute on Aging, the CDC, the Alzheimer’s Association, the Alzheimer’s Foundation of America, the Family Caregiver Alliance and the NHS, and on peer-reviewed research such as Cochrane reviews and large clinical trials. Every guide lists the sources it relies on. We open each source before citing it, and we only report what it actually says.

How we write

  • Practical first: what to do today, in plain language.
  • Honest about evidence: we say “linked with”, “may” and “the evidence is mixed” when that is the truth.
  • Respectful: we write about people living with dementia as adults, and we never use quizzing or shaming language.
  • No invented content: no made-up statistics, quotes, experts, studies, reviews or testimonials.

Who reviews our pages

Pages are written and checked by the Creative Activities team. Some drafting and research use AI tools, as described below. Every page is checked against its sources by the team. Our pages have not been reviewed by a doctor or other clinician, and we do not claim otherwise. They are general information, not medical advice.

How AI is used

We use AI tools to help with research, first drafts, translation drafts and formatting. A person edits every page against its sources. AI does not test activities: a person tries each activity before it is published. No AI-generated step, image or review is presented as verified, and we do not publish AI-written reviews or testimonials. No generated image is shown as a photo of a real activity.

What we will never publish

  • Claims that a game, food, supplement, fast or routine prevents, treats, slows or cures dementia.
  • Tests, quizzes or scores that suggest someone has, or does not have, dementia.
  • Advice to start, stop or change any medicine.
  • Advertising or sponsored content disguised as guidance.

Updates and corrections

Each page shows the date it was last updated. If you find a mistake or an out-of-date source, please email {email} and we will check it promptly.

faq.title: Caemh Caeuq Dap
faq.seoTitle: Youxsiz Caeuq Hozdung Binghcizdaih: Caemh Caeuq Dap
faq.description: Dap caemh itbuen gvanhyi youxsiz caeuq hozdung binghcizdaih: youxsiz lawz liux yawj, liux geijlai, iqdangq laux mwh, gengjgeiq naonao caeuq swjmat.
faq.lede: Dap duemh, gemh cdoiq caemh boux ciuqgu caemh lai ceiq.

items.q: Youxsiz lawz ndei ceiq cdoiq boux miz binghcizdaih?
items.a: Youxsiz ndei ceiq dwg rox ndei, jiendanh caeuq mbouj miz yaetlig, giz hox dwg maz boux mwngz ciuqgu hwnjloih mwhneix. Gap duenh vah miz heuq yawj, faen buhnfaenh, puzduenh vah caep, buengz vah heuq rox ndei, daep saek caeuq bingo duenh vah zung ndei cdoiq lai boux. Siengq cung daengqsiz, faenbuek caeuq maz maz lumj gwnz gaoj.
Ndei. Youysi caeuq bieb cawjyinq doq mienjfauh, mbouj aeu canghhu, danghciq, haicaiq roxneuaz guenghgauq.

items.q: Maznamh mbouj miz deiphaen, gaepbied caeuq dinghsizgi?
items.a: Gvai caeuq deiphaen yaeng hawj hoatdoengh fwenloih bienx baenz gauqsik, raeuh hawj boux heiqngwngq roxneuaz yaepsim. Dou aeu sim saed youq gwnz fwenloih caeuq sizgan caezyouq, couh mbouj miz maz caekbaih, mwngz yaep gizlawz doq ndaej dingx.

Sjgei, bingjbanj roxneuaz denznauj miz liuxlangjgi moq doq ndaej yungh. Bingjbanj cawz youq gwnz coengz dingz song boux caezyouq doxdauh ciengz sufsug. Denznauj biengq denhsih yaeuj doh lai boux caez raenh.

items.q: Dou ndaej yungh ciuqbenq ranz he lai raenh lox?
items.a: Ndei. Ciq-ciuqbenq aeu 2 daengz 6 jeuh ciuqbenq mwngz genx bienx baenz youysi beijdoih. Ciuqbenq gvaq youq ndaw liuxlangjgi mwngz, mbouj cungj sanghconz roxneuaz bauhcwznz.

items.q: Baez hoatdoengh aeu gvaq lai gouj sizgan?
items.a: Ciengzcangz 10 daengz 20 faencungh couh gouq lo, mizbaez 2 faencungh couh baenz lo. Yawj boux mwngz yawjkonq roxneuaz naeuh ngwix naeuh yaepsim rox mbouj, youq danghcawq yangh simndei couh dingx. Mbouj miz sizgan geizdingh.

items.q: Danghsaw bouxde mbouj aeu guh hoatdoengh couh baenzlawz?
items.a: Cuenhcungh bouxde mbouj aeu, roengxsik aeu baezlaeng roxneuaz lai fanhfap wnq lwnz. Mbouj aeu coengz ndaej laeuz vih naeuh ngwix, cep, sim mbouj daenh roxneuaz mbouj miz hingqsih. Yawj bieb cijdauj dou guh baenzlawz danghsaw bouxde naeuh mbouj aeu.

items.q: Bingh mwhmbeih ciengzlaeng aeu guh hoatdoengh maz?
items.a: Sufsug caeuq gamjsik: dingx fwen he ndei, nungx runghfuhsoeng anhmo fwg, caez yawj ciuqbenq, nanh buh he onq, naengh youq baihrog ranz, roxneuaz miz boux caezyouq doxdauh ciuqbenq ciengz gaanhdanh. Bieb cijdauj ciengzlaeng dou miz lai lizfaep.

items.q: Ndaw ranz yawjkonq miz hoatdoengh doh lai boux lox?
items.a: Miz. Ciuqbenq Binghgo miz baez cawjyinq caeuq yingjbingz heiq mingz, ciengzdaep vahyouh caeuq baez doxdamq doq ndei doeg ok sing. Bieb cijdauj doh lai boux ndaw ranz yawjkonq dou guen lai boux, cawz dingz naengh caeuq faenhfap gaijbienq doh nengxlig mbouj doengz.

items.q: Youysi ndaej fanghfanz roxneuaz dimgvaq bingh mwhmbeih lox?
items.a: Mbouj miz youysi ndaej biujmingz fanghfanz bingh mwhmbeih, youysi dou cungj mbouj naeuh yienghneix. Yenzgiu biujmingz hoatdoengh yizsik ndaw siqvei doh boux miz bingh mwhmbeih onq roxneuaz cungjdengj miz di ndei, hoeng neix caeuq youysi fanghfanz bingh couh mbouj doengz. Dou hawj youysi couh vih fwenloih caeuq caezyouq.

Mbouj ndaej khokdingh. Yenzgiu liengx 14 dingz saeh gienghgangh caeuq sanghhoh caeuq fengyiemj bingh mwhmbeih, baenzneix rw haeh, huetap sang, mbouj hoatdoengh daej caeuq doeglaeb. Gaijbienq gij neix ndaej giemj di fengyiemj hawj boux he, hoeng lai boux guh ndei liux doq yangh ndaej bingh mwhmbeih. Neix mbouj roxneuaz loq bouxlawz.

items.q: Mbouj gwn haeux dingz sizgan ndei doh nauj gienghgangh lox?
items.a: Human evidence is limited and early, and much of the research is in animals. Fasting can be risky for older adults, especially with diabetes medicines or unintended weight loss, and it is not recommended for people living with dementia. Talk with a doctor before changing how you eat.
